title: identity.member.role_changed.v1
description: The org role of a member changed (M2 spec #29). Identity writes it in the same transaction as the membership change. CloudEvents subject: the user sub. The orgid extension holds org_id. actor is user:<sub> for an API call, or system when the change came from Zitadel. No email, no personal name. Operator is a platform role and never appears here.

user_sub.description: Subject id (token sub) of the member. Never an email.

new_role.description: Org role after the change. The producer never emits a change to the same role (the schema cannot express old_role != new_role).
